article.story: LEXINGTON, Ky. -- — Malachi Moreno scored 22 points and grabbed 12 rebounds as Kentucky pulled away in the second half to beat Grambling 88-59 on Monday. The Wildcats (4-1) led just 36-30 at halftime after Grambling cut the margin to one late in the first half. Kentucky closed the period with a surge, capped by Mason Williams’ 40-foot 3-pointer at the buzzer. The Wildcats opened the second half with a 20-5 run, bumping the lead to 56-35 with 13:51 remaining. Milan Momcilovic hit two 3-pointers during the stretch, while Zoom Diallo and Moreno also scored. Moreno finished 8 of 14 from the field and added four steals and three blocks. Diallo, Momcilovic and Mason Williams all had 12 points. Momcilovic also had nine rebounds and nine assists. Kentucky shot 46% from the field, made 10 3-pointers and outrebounded Grambling 49-33. Isaiah Miranda led Grambling (1-2) with 18 points, while Isaiah Howard added 16 off the bench. The Tigers shot 30% from the field and 21% from 3-point range. Up next Kentucky: Hosts Indiana on Friday. Grambling: Plays Southern Miss this Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
